purpose: Independent arithmetic and accounting triangulation of the unchanged owned operating forecast; test whether a LONG is justified without selecting a multiple to hit a target.

current.timestamp: 16:00:00 EST market close per MarketScreener; Schwab corroborates same price at 15:59 ET

exit_policy: Cash-yield grid is fixed before calculation, deliberately broad and uncalibrated to peers. No point is selected as fair value. It represents a sensitivity, not independent empirical corroboration.

Normalize parent unlevered cash by removing net finite credits: old credit collection plus new credit collection less associated basis-loss tax. Retain those net finite flows as a separately discounted asset or liability through2040, with no terminal credit value.
Use2031 normalized cash as the forward exit metric and2030 normalized cash as an explicitly labeled trailing-metric sensitivity. Both end at Dec31,2030; do not add2030 cash flow to cash again.

Exit operating value equals normalized parent operating cash divided by assumed cash yield, plus future net finite-credit PV. Financing-shield PV is a separate APV benefit, never embedded in the specified unlevered cash-yield assumption.

Add projected economic-owner cash, subtract ordinary debt, and add net other assets once. Do not deduct separately the modeled lease cash claim or minority claims already netted from parent cash; do not add consolidated subsidiaries stake values.

Operating value divided by consolidated EBIT/NOPAT is an internal diagnostic, not a peer-comparable EV multiple. No market EV/EBIT valuation is presented without reconciling lease, minority and financing scope.
The forward cash-yield method leaves future growth and capital needs embedded in the selected yield. A yield grid does not validate the forecasts or justify favorable long-run ROC.
unchanged: All active annual operating forecasts, taxes, capital policy, credits, cash balances, debt runoff, shares and additional claims.
Prior model and research files. No implementation change to existing valuation.
entry_policy: Report current-date annual price return and entry ceiling at each chosen hurdle for verified existing cases; no distributions assumed.
Twenty-percent discount to Dec2026 planning value is a separately chosen margin sensitivity, not a claim of Nov6 fair value.
Conditional entry is the minimum of a20% discount to Dec2026 case value and a12% future-price-return ceiling for that same case. This is an analyst rule, not an optimized or universal margin.
No new same-day DCF is claimed. Dec31,2026 opening cash forecast and year-end cash flows cannot be relabeled Nov6 without a dated bridge and consistent equity risk.
